caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with two main sections, rendered in shades of light brown and tan, giving the appearance of natural wood grain. The upper section consists of two vertical rectangular doors with inset panels, each with a round dark knob handle in the center. Below the doors, there are two horizontal drawers, each fitted with a similarly dark knob. The lower section of the cabinet mirrors the upper section, with two larger vertical doors featuring inset panels and matching dark round knob handles placed in the center where the doors meet. The cabinet has straight lines and a flat top, with four short legs slightly flaring outward at the base. The background is a light beige color, and there are no other objects or elements in the image.
title: Shaker Cupboard
